prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2.5D fantasy game perimeter scenery atlas.
Reference image is the approved bright B03 Pumpkin Town gameplay preview. Match only its sunny hand-painted cream/mint/lavender/pumpkin village materials, near-isometric 3/4 camera and cozy funny undead civilization. Do not copy HUD, player, enemies or full ground screenshot.
Generate ONE real transparent RGBA PNG, approximately 2400 x 1200, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS of EQUAL INVISIBLE CELLS. EXACTLY EIGHT separate complete standalone perimeter objects, one per cell, in precise reading order below. Each object must use AT MOST 65% of its cell width and height. Keep broad clear transparent gutters and at least 18% completely transparent margin on EVERY cell edge. Complete roofs, tree leaves, flower tips and shadows must remain far inside that cell. No object may touch another cell. All outside empty area is alpha 0. No text, no labels, no drawn grid or borders.
These are loose scene cutouts the engine places around the exterior; they are NOT eight rectangular floor tiles, NOT tiny rooms, and NOT a rendered whole map. Never paint a shared backdrop. No ground plane or square platform. Tiny attached structural footings and small partially transparent contact shadows are allowed. All objects share the same high three-quarter near-isometric camera, clean hand-painted outlines, readable 2.5D volume, softly sunny upper-left illumination and game-consistent object proportions. Do not present flat top-down icons.

Row 1 cell 1, B03_edge_east: LOW GRAVE RAILING — a short low cream/mint stone-and-wood grave fence with just two little friendly rounded hat headstones, one on each side, delicate brass buckles, small lavender and white flowers. Wide but low, porous/open structure, not a high solid wall. Complete isolated structure, organic feet without a pavement rectangle.
Row 1 cell 2, B03_edge_corner: PUMPKIN FLOWERBED CORNER — an organic L-curving low cluster of orange pumpkins, mint leaves, lilac blossoms and white daisies, suitable for a natural outer corner. The opening of the L remains transparent. No rectangular soil tile, no raised terrain slab or wall.
Row 1 cell 3, B03_edge_backdrop: DISTANT LAVENDER COTTAGE — one compact complete sunny cream-and-mint village cottage with lilac tiles, rounded windows, pumpkin doorknob, patchwork awning, little flower boxes and a tiny crooked-hat chimney. Lower-detail distant background scenery but readable and polished. No street plane and no additional sprawling buildings.
Row 1 cell 4, B03_edge_gateway: COFFIN POST-OFFICE ENTRY GATE — a lightweight open town-entry arch formed from two little cream/mint posts, a curved lavender hat brim lintel and a small smiling coffin-envelope emblem. Warm lantern on each side, a small ribbon. Broad open walk-through center; no giant building, no closed gate, no wall stretched from a ground texture and no letter or text.

Row 2 cell 1, B03_edge_north: SUNLIT GRAVEYARD TREE — one complete friendly round-crowned tree with warm mint-green leaves, a few hanging tiny pumpkin fruits, a lilac cloth ribbon, cream flowers at the trunk foot and soft warm sunlit highlights. Trunk and ALL foliage tips visible. No ominous black canopy and no rectangle of terrain.
Row 2 cell 2, B03_edge_south: EXTERIOR PIER SHORELINE — one compact curved cream-stone shore lip with a short mint/wood dock edging and a few low plants; BEYOND the curve, only a very narrow irregular turquoise shallow-water fringe with a couple tiny lily pads. Outside silhouette organic and transparent, NOT a large water plane, NOT a rectangular pool or floor tile. No boat in this cell. This curve is used outside the playable arena and never cuts the indoor walking floor.
Row 2 cell 3, B03_edge_foreground: LOW FOREGROUND FLOWERS — a gentle wide crescent of low mint leaves, orange pumpkin blossoms, tiny white daisies and a couple lilac petals, bright soft foreground decoration. Leaves stay low and sparse enough not to obstruct the player's silhouette. Entire cluster has organic outline and transparent empty center; no dirt rectangle.
Row 2 cell 4, B03_edge_west: GHOST TEA-STALL EAVES — one airy low mint wooden tea-stall porch with a lilac/cream patchwork short awning, small carved teapot emblem, dangling brass spoon chimes and one pumpkin cup on a little side shelf. Open center and slim posts, with no tall opaque wall, no humanoid/ghost character, no lettering and no full stall crowd.

Constraints: eight objects only; exact 4x2 reading order; genuine alpha transparency including all four image corners and wide gutters; no checkerboard painted into pixels, no black/white/gray/parchment background; no UI, no text, no enemies or heroes; no dense mini-map scenes; no continuous tiled borders, no gray ring, no large rectangular pits/pools, no vertically stretched ground texture, no large shadow/backdrop; no industrial steam winch or wire coils; no night lighting, no gore, no rotting bodies; complete isolated modest low scenery that naturally extends the sunny B03 town environment.
